description: Keeps the native media libraries, the Docker base images and the GitHub Actions current. Maven and npm dependencies are left alone so that merges from upstream Smithereen stay simple.

customManagers.description: Versions in docker/native/*/versions.env, each with a '# renovate:' comment on the line above
matchStrings: # renovate: datasource=(?<datasource>\S+) depName=(?<depName>\S+)( packageName=(?<packageName>\S+))?( registryUrl=(?<registryUrl>\S+))?( extractVersion=(?<extractVersion>\S+))?( versioning=(?<versioning>\S+))?\n[A-Z0-9_]+=(?<currentValue>\S+)

packageRules.description: One PR for libvips and everything linked into it, built and tested together
One PR for ffmpeg and its codecs
Odd GLib minor versions are development releases
Pin base images by digest, so that their security updates arrive as PRs too
A new Ubuntu LTS, Java or Maven major version is a deliberate change, not a routine update
